texts.zh:
大气中积聚的电荷导致了两极地区的剧烈温度变化。让以前无法到达的冻土带发生了解冻。

现在我们可以开发这片新发现的土地了。
texts.en:
The increased electrical charge in the atmosphere has led to a drastic temperature shift in the polar region, causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.

We can now develop this newly-uncovered land.

# 融化冰川 / Melting Glaciers

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/cosmic_storms_events_1.txt:3280-3423; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5437 · DLC: Cosmic Storms · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

电、粒子、引力、磁、太阳或天体风暴离开拥有寒冷殖民地的星系时（00_on_actions.txt:5437），隐藏事件 cstorms.1750 标记该星球，90天后 cstorms.1751 确认并弹出 cstorms.1755。

When an electric, particle, gravity, magnetic, solar or celestial storm leaves a system with a cold colony (00_on_actions.txt:5437) hidden cstorms.1750 marks the planet and, 90 days later, cstorms.1751 confirms and shows cstorms.1755.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

cstorms.1755“融化冰川”：正文随风暴类型而变。

cstorms.1755 "Melting Glaciers": text varies with the storm type.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项“令人着迷”：移除巨大冰川矿点，换成“宜居苔原”矿点，获得矿物收入并推进冰川科技。

Single option "Fascinating": the massive glacier deposit is replaced by a forgiving tundra deposit, mineral income and progress on the glacier tech.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

Cosmic Storms DLC；每国一次。

Cosmic Storms DLC; once per country.
